criteria.text: Identifies that the comfort letter cut-off of 13 February 2026 is 12 days before the 25 February 2026 pricing date, outside the 3-business-day requirement in Clause 7(b), so a bring-down letter is needed.
Calculates the underwriting commission as $25,900,000 (7.0% of gross proceeds of $370,000,000) and identifies that the stated $22,015,000 is wrong.
Identifies that the Underwriting Agreement lacks selling restrictions (e.g. Rule 144A / Regulation S for the US, prospectus exemptions for Canada and the EEA) and recommends adding them.
Shows the commission arithmetic (20,000,000 x $18.50 = $370,000,000; x 7.0% = $25,900,000) and flags the discrepancy.
States the gap between cut-off and pricing as a duration (12 calendar days) and identifies the latest compliant cut-off date.
Where a defined term or clause is ambiguous, explains how each alternative reading would work.
